title: Business Website Development
desc: I create modern, responsive websites that look professional and work perfectly on mobile phones, tablets, and desktops. Your website will load smoothly, showcase your business clearly, and make a great first impression on every visitor.

title: Google-Friendly Websites
desc: I build websites with SEO best practices so your business has a better chance of appearing in Google search results. This helps more people find your business, increases online visibility, and brings more potential customers.

title: Custom Web Applications
desc: Need something beyond a website? I develop custom web applications such as dashboards, booking systems, customer portals, and business management tools that simplify your daily work and improve productivity.

title: Fast Website Performance
desc: A slow website can lose customers. I improve your website's speed and performance so pages load quickly, visitors stay engaged, and your business provides a better online experience.

title: Website Updates & Support
desc: Your website needs regular care to stay secure and reliable. I provide updates, fix issues, improve features, and offer ongoing support so your website continues to run smoothly.

title: Website Security
desc: I help protect your website from common security threats by implementing essential security measures. This keeps your business, customer data, and website safe while giving visitors confidence in your brand.
